messages:
maria_ml: bringing up seraph9b (int4) on rtx-a100 pool for staging load test. baseline perf looks OK but hitting OOMs ~1–2% of requests under 60 concurrent connections. memory fragmentation traces attached.

kai_runtime: can you paste the alloc logs? frag usually shows as lots of small free blocks after prefetch.

maria_ml: pasted snippet: ```
[2026-02-18T14:22:11Z] alloc: 78% used, free_chunks: 3421, largest_free: 24MB
[2026-02-18T14:22:11Z] kv_cache: 1.2GB
[2026-02-18T14:22:11Z] prefetched_kv: 128MB
```

maria_ml: note: we use max_new_tokens=256 default during beam evals; switching to 128 drops p50/p95 a bit but seems to reduce OOMs.

kai_runtime: initial thoughts: int4 reduces model memory but increases fragmentation risk because we do more small GPU allocations for quant blocks. prefetch size + batch packing interplay is key.

devon_sre: are these OOMs full CUDA OOM or our runtime catching failed alloc? logs?

maria_ml: runtime reports cudaMalloc failed, but sometimes recoverable after a few seconds (OOM during high-burst tails).

lena_prodeng: did you try disabling prefetch entirely for this model? that was helpful for similar 9B-quant cases.

maria_ml: yes — disabled prefetch -> OOM rate dropped 60% but latency p95 increased ~40ms. tradeoff is noticeable.

kai_runtime: try smaller prefetch window + aggressive KV trimming. e.g., set prefetch_kv_bytes=64MB and kv_trim_threshold=0.6. also reduce batch.max_new_tokens default to 96 for this model class.

maria_ml: running canary with: ```json
{"model":"seraph9b-int4","prefetch_kv_bytes":67108864,"kv_trim_threshold":0.6,"batch_max_new_tokens":96,"max_batch_size":8}
```

perf-bot: perf alert created: canary 5% traffic -> baseline latency vs canary diff: p50 +3ms, p95 +35ms, error-rate +0.1%.

devon_sre: also look at cudaMallocRetry/backoff config. bumping retry attempts to 3 helped similar bursts elsewhere.

kai_runtime: if frag persists, consider periodic GPU heap compaction: schedule compaction during quiet windows (we have a runtime hook: /admin/compact-heap). compaction cost ~50ms but prevents long tail OOMs.

maria_ml: after 24h canary: OOMs down from 1.8% -> 0.12%, p95 still ~+30ms but acceptable for staging. We'll try compaction hook next to recover p95.

lena_prodeng: documented config in model-catalog under seraph9b-int4: recommend starting defaults: prefetch_kv_bytes=64MB, kv_trim_threshold=0.6, batch_max_new_tokens=96, compaction_every_n_minutes=30 (opt-in).

maria_ml: filing a follow-up PR to add eval prompts showing quality diff between 96 vs 256 tokens (we saw tiny drop on long-form summarization). pinging @lena_prodeng for review.

kai_runtime: nice. keep an eye on memory growth over 72h; fragmentation can creep back with long-lived workers.

perf-bot: ticket created: INF-2147 "seraph9b-int4: prefetch/kv defaults + compaction to mitigate frag OOMs"

maria_ml: thanks all — will update after compaction test. :thumbsup:
